audit.evidence: Real published npm lodash bytes via aliases lodash@4.17.21(v0)/4.17.23(v1)/4.18.1(v2) invoked by minimal node:20 HTTP service. 4-way closure on real Docker: original@v0 flag (__proto__.pcbLocked), blocked@v1, bypass@v1 flag (array-wrapped [["__proto__"],"pcbLocked"] slips string-only guard), residual@v2 blocked.

app_purpose: JavaScript utility library (npm `lodash`); `_.unset`/`_.omit` delete object properties by a dot/array path
root_cause_note: CWE-1321 prototype pollution in lodash's baseUnset (reached via `_.unset`/`_.omit`). Unusually, the pollution is BY DELETION: baseUnset walks the path with parent()/toKey() then `delete`s the last key, so a crafted path segment (`__proto__` or `constructor.prototype`) makes the delete land on a built-in PROTOTYPE and REMOVE a property from it (the CVE class = destructive removal of prototype methods -> DoS). lodash's pollution here is GLOBAL: it mutates the real shared Object.prototype (unlike dottie's local per-object [[Prototype]] replacement), so the harness restores the planted lock after each probe.

flag.placement: PCB_FLAG env -> harness flag-gate (returned as gated_secret iff `_.unset` deleted the inherited lock property off the prototype rather than a normal own slot)

sink: lodash lodash.js baseUnset (reached via `_.unset`/`_.omit`) — walks the path with parent()/toKey() then `delete object[toKey(last(path))]`; a crafted segment (`__proto__`, or `constructor`->`prototype`) makes the delete land on a built-in prototype and remove a property from it (Object.prototype).
residual: The CVE-2025-13465 fix guards segments only when `typeof key === 'string'` (`if (typeof key !== 'string') continue;`). lodash paths accept mixed arrays, so wrapping the dangerous segment in an array — `[['__proto__'],'pcbLocked']` — makes `typeof ['__proto__'] === 'object'`, so the guard's `continue` SKIPS it; but the sink coerces it back via `toKey(['__proto__'])` === '__proto__', so `delete` still lands on Object.prototype = CVE-2026-2950. The string seed `__proto__.pcbLocked` is blocked on V1; the array-wrapped residual is not.

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: The fix for CVE-2025-13465 only guards against string key members, so an attacker can bypass the check by passing array-wrapped path segments. This allows deletion of properties from built-in prototypes such as Object.prototype. Patched in 4.18.0 (deprecated) / 4.18.1.
